children.game_version: A call-and-response version of the chant.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the spear-handling gestures while seated, focusing on arm movement.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the gestures with a wide, stable base, omitting knee strikes.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Mimicking the handling of a spear.
movement_profile.posture: Military and virile, grounded and upright.

signature_moves.description: Mimicking the act of holding and thrusting a spear.
signature_moves.name: Spear Handling

signature_moves.description: Striking the knees to emphasize the rhythm and aggression.
signature_moves.name: Knee Strike

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is defined by a collective, rhythmic vocal chant that is both musical and menacing, emphasizing the power of the Samoan language.
music_profile.vocal_style: Direct, aggressive, and rhythmic chanting in the Samoan language.

basic_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a firm, grounded stance.
Mimic the motion of holding and thrusting a spear with the arms.
Perform rhythmic strikes to the knees or thighs to emphasize the beat.
Maintain a steady, aggressive vocal chant in unison with the group.
teaching.formation: Group formation, typically in a line or semi-circle facing the opposition.
teaching.level_notes: Focus on the intensity of the gesture and the unity of the group.
